system.name: GPUlog
system.one_liner: a GPU-based Datalog engine backend that implements relational algebra kernels over a range-indexed hash data structure (HISA)

content.subject: how a GPU thread strides through the outer relation Foo and probes a hash-indexed sorted array built over the inner relation Bar to produce per-thread join results

content.key_idea: GPUlog parallelizes a join by having each GPU thread stride through the outer relation and probe a shared hash-indexed sorted array (HISA) built from the inner relation, so many threads can look up matches concurrently instead of scanning.

summary: This figure works through GPUlog's GPU-parallel hash join between two 3-attribute relations, Foo (outer) and Bar (inner), that share their first two columns as join keys. The Outer Relation is divided into strides (columns T0 through Tn), one tuple per GPU thread per stride, so many threads retrieve outer tuples concurrently. Each thread's tuple feeds the Join operator, which hashes the shared join-key columns to probe a Hash Table (worked examples like K: hash(1,2), V: 0); the resulting value is an offset into the Inner Relation's Sorted Index Array, itself built over a Data Array of Bar's tuples, together forming the hash-indexed sorted array (HISA). Matching inner tuples found through this probe are combined with the outer tuple to produce that thread's rows in the per-stride Join Results tables shown on the right. Colour-coded numerals (red values, green positions, purple keys, olive stored values) let the reader trace one concrete tuple's path from the outer relation through the hash index to its joined result.
summary_zh: 该图演示GPUlog在GPU上并行执行哈希连接的过程：外关系Foo按线程分stride并发取元组，经Join操作对共享的前两列做哈希，探查Hash Table得到偏移，定位到内关系Bar的Sorted Index Array和Data Array（即HISA结构），匹配元组与外元组组合，产生各线程的Join Results表。
